title: Alicia - incredible guide
text: Alicia was fantastic - fun, interesting and an amazing guide

title: A Tour of Seville through Foos
text: Albania was very informative about the food we ate. The selections she chose were all very good and gave us a true taste of Seville favorites. Would definitely recommend this tour.
author: Rinn62

title: Excellent secret food tour
text: Alice was excellent tour guide. Very much enjoyed the tour.
author: marcyp188

title: Enjoyable Evening in Sevilla
text: Sarah was a friendly and informative guide.  My friend and I enjoyed learning about the history of Sevilla in addition to sampling the food and drinks during the tour.  The tour was a wonderful way to spend an evening in Sevilla.
author: wahoowa91

title: Elio is the perfect guide
text: We chose to do the tour on our first day in Seville and used the wonderful bars and amazing food as the template for our meals for the rest of our trip. Elio is the perfect guide, knowledgeable, enthusiastic and organised. He’d planned a well balanced itinerary, paced it perfectly and then provided the details of where we’d been and what we’d eaten - simple to replicate for the following nights. A ten out of ten from us.
author: alisonka

title: Danielle was the best tour guide ever!
text: Danielle was the perfect tour guide. We lucked out with the booking and the tour was just her and us. She was very knowledgeable about the area and has a passion for food. We were stuffed by the end! I will recommend this tour to all my friends. We had the best time!
author: R7630CUvirginiah

title: Fantastic (everything!!!)
text: What a great evening!!! The food was varied and nicely paired. We learned a lot, no only about the food and wines but about many other things to do. Elio answered all our questions with a smile, he took great care of us making the experience extra enjoyable. I would recommend it, to discover the city and everything else that has to offer :) happy customer!!
author: prosado

title: A wonderful evening of food, drinks & walking with Elio
text: The charming Elio was our guide on this informative tour of tapas bars, churros and jamon. Several highlights including a visit to his wife’s charcuterie and valuable insights into the rules of Iberian jamon. We covered both sides of Sevilla ending up in Triana and a marvellous meal of mushrooms with aioli & pork skewers washed down with Sangria. It was a beautiful evening and highly recommend Elio’s guidance.
author: Marian T

title: Great food tour with Elio!
text: Elio was a great guide for this wonderful tour of Sevillan foods.  His knowledge of the history of Seville, local insights and familiarity of food in Seville was wonderful to hear.  We loved that we started with a snack of churros and ended with delicious pork loin.  The places we visited provided wonderful atmosphere and hospitality.
author: ReallyDave

title: A must do in Seville
text: Elio was so personable, it felt like we knew him for a while. He took us to some amazing places that we would not have found otherwise plus gave us some history with each place. We loved each part of this tour and would highly recommend for anyone in Seville.  Thank you Elio!!
author: rcbresee
